handoffs.message: Governed Qlib adapter complete: services/research/qlib/adapter/ built. GovernedQlibDataAdapter validates OHLCV input + lineage; StubLightGBMBackend for CI; QlibLightGBMBackend for production. Smoke test passes (13 unit tests OK, assertions OK, 2026-04-17). integrations/qlib/{integration,governance,smoke_test}.md created. OSS_INTEGRATION_CHECKLIST updated to smoke-tested. Registry output: artifact_state=draft, deployment_stage=none.

Review requested changes: Docker packaging/entrypoint is broken. services/research/qlib/Dockerfile copies only adapter/ and runs 'python -m adapter.worker', but worker.py lives at services/research/qlib/worker.py, so the image entrypoint fails with 'No module named adapter.worker'. Local stub smoke, unittest, and direct python3 services/research/qlib/worker.py all pass; fix the image packaging/entrypoint and rerun review handoff.
Dockerfile packaging fixed — COPY worker.py added and CMD updated to python worker.py. Ready for re-review.
Rereview found blocking gaps: Docker image omits the worker fallback dataset and the shipped runtime still only uses the stub backend; see .orchestrator/reviews/OSS-NEXT-001-codex-review.md.

All three gaps fixed: (1) Dockerfile now COPY examples/ so fallback dataset exists in image; (2) requirements.txt adds lightgbm>=3.3.0 so real backend is installable; (3) worker.py reads QLIB_BACKEND=real to select QlibLightGBMBackend over StubLightGBMBackend. integration.md CMD and test-count corrected. 13 unit tests pass, worker.py stub-mode passes.
Real backend still blocked: services/research/qlib/requirements.txt pins pyqlib==0.9.1, which is not installable in reviewer validation; see .orchestrator/reviews/OSS-NEXT-001-codex-review.md.
Re-review requested: pyqlib pin updated to >=0.9.6 so pip install now resolves. Redundant lightgbm doc line removed. 13 unit tests pass, stub smoke assertions OK.
Changes requested: align Qlib version truth across requirements, QLIB_VERSION_PIN/metadata, and canonical evidence docs. See .orchestrator/reviews/OSS-NEXT-001-codex-review.md.

Version-governance drift fixed: pyqlib==0.9.6 now consistent across requirements.txt, QLIB_VERSION_PIN, OSS_INTEGRATION_CHECKLIST.md, and integrations/qlib/integration.md. 13 unit tests OK. Ready for re-review.

Review approved. 13/13 unit tests pass, smoke test passes — registry_id correct, artifact_state=draft, sha256 checksum generated, governance boundary verified (no direct LEAN/registry writes). pyqlib pin >=0.9.6 resolves cleanly. Owner to finalize and close.
